name: Izanagi Shrine
description: Awaji's principal shrine dedicated to Izanagi and Izanami, surrounded by evergreen grounds and known for its sacred husband-and-wife camphor trees. It is one shrine outing, not a split mythology card.

en.name: Izanagi Shrine
en.description: Awaji's principal shrine dedicated to Izanagi and Izanami, surrounded by evergreen grounds and known for its sacred husband-and-wife camphor trees. It is one shrine outing, not a split mythology card.
en.notes: The official Awaji tourism guide identifies this as the oldest shrine associated with the creation myth and places it in Awaji City. Observe shrine etiquette and current worship guidance.
en.reservation: Ordinary worship is not represented as a timed-ticket attraction; check the shrine's current worship and event guidance.
en.parking: Check the shrine's current parking guidance; Awaji Island tourism advises highway bus and car access because there are no trains on the island.
en.openingHours: Hours and closures vary by date; check the official visitor guidance before visiting.

ja.name: 伊弉諾神宮
ja.description: 伊弉諾大神と伊弉冉大神をまつる淡路島の一宮で、常緑の境内と夫婦大楠で知られる神社です。神話の要素を分割せず、一つの参拝体験として扱います。
highlights: 伊弉諾大神・伊弉冉大神の祭祀
